title: The Drought and the Prophets' Lies
description: A severe drought strikes Judah; the wells are dry and the people mourn. Jeremiah prays for the Lord to intervene for His name's sake, but God answers that He will not hear their prayers because of the people's sin. When Jeremiah points to the false prophets' promise of peace, the Lord declares that both the prophets who have deceived the people and the people themselves will perish by sword, famine, and pestilence.
